grader.method: Two independent, blind, tool-less grader runs, one per review, each in a fresh --safe-mode empty-temp-dir context. Runtime grader prompts were generated by validate_eval.py's shared helpers (extract_grader_template + build_grader_prompt via regenerate_grader_prompt) so the recorded prompt regenerates byte-for-byte during validation.
